name: Bland AI
tagline: Enterprise voice AI that runs on its own infrastructure, build calls as conversational pathways, priced all-in per minute.
verdict: Bland AI’s pitch is ownership: it runs its own self-hosted model stack instead of stitching together third-party providers, which underpins a genuinely strong compliance story (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, EU/APAC residency, on-prem) and an all-in per-minute price with no confusing model pass-throughs. Its Conversational Pathways give the deterministic, auditable control that regulated call flows demand. Be clear-eyed about the limits, though: the marketed 400ms latency and 40+-language support are vendor-reported without independent benchmarking, and support leans on the public Discord community and self-service below the Enterprise tier. Pick Bland if you are an enterprise that values infrastructure control, compliance and predictable pricing above all; skip it if you want a fast, no-code, multilingual agent with hands-on support at a starter price.
